record.body:
## Description

Fix the failure that blocked closing verification: the verify tdd acceptance selects zero tests.

## Approach

Add CLI-level tests in tests/test_close_batch.py whose names match both `cli` and (`oracle` or `freeze` or `assertion_level` or `amendment`). Cover refuse (hash drift / non-assertion red) and happy path through the real close-batch CLI entry (bin/aff close-batch), not unit-only helpers. Do not widen beyond close_batch tests.
record.subject: fix-oracle-cli-tests
